basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat Kanker, Chhattisgarh Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat Kanker, Chhattisgarh has announced 4 vacancies for the Accountant (Contract) post on a contract basis for 1 year, which is renewable for 1 year based on performance and mutual consent. Eligible applicants must possess a Bachelor of Commerce with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST), with a second class pass for Bastar and Sarguja divisions. Candidates are required to apply online on or before 1 November 2026 at 12:00 midnight. The selection process consists of a Merit List, Document Verification, and Computer Practical Exam.

how_to_apply: Access the designated online registration portal at zpkanker.indicompute.com or through www.kanker.gov.in.

Fill in personal details, residential address, category, and active Chhattisgarh employment registration number. Candidates will be solely responsible for any incorrect entry, and no correction will be permitted once submitted.
Enter academic qualifications including Higher Secondary and B.Com details, along with marks obtained.

Upload self-attested copies of essential certificates including the Chhattisgarh local resident certificate, permanent caste certificate, live employment exchange card, mark sheets, and medical board certificate (for PwD candidates).
Attach the appointment order, experience certificate, and current employer NOC if claiming marks for experience in government rural development schemes.
Submit the online application before the closing time of 12:00 midnight on 01 November 2026. Late applications will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Candidates must hold an active employment exchange registration certificate from Chhattisgarh; applications without an attested copy of a valid live certificate will be rejected. Eligible candidates will be called for document verification in a 1:5 ratio; absent candidates or those appearing with incomplete documents will not be granted a second opportunity under any circumstances. No travelling allowance (TA) or any other allowance will be paid for attending document verification or examinations; candidates must attend at their own expense and arrangements. Candidates currently serving in government offices must present a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer. All updates, claims and objections lists, call letters, merit lists, and final select lists will be published exclusively on the district portal (www.kanker.gov.in). The number of advertised positions may be increased or decreased based on the creation of contingency funds under the VB-G RAM G mission. Resolution of any objections in the recruitment process will be made by the Collector & District Programme Coordinator VB-G RAM G, and that decision shall be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 contract vacancies have been released for the Accountant (Contract) post under the Viksit Bharat - Rojgar aur Aajeevika ke liye Guarantee Mission (Gramin). Note: All 4 vacancies fall under the Open/Free category (Mukt) according to the reservation roster (UR: 1 Open, ST: 2 Open, OBC: 1 Open).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet all the eligibility criteria specified below before submitting their online application: Nationality & Domicile: The applicant must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh State. A valid domicile certificate issued by a competent authority in the prescribed format is mandatory. Educational Qualification: Must have passed a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) with at least 55% marks. Candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories require a minimum of 50% marks. For candidates belonging to the Bastar and Sarguja divisions, passing in second class is required. Required educational qualifications must be completed on or before the date of application submission. Employment Registration: The applicant must possess an active and live registration certificate from an Employment Exchange (Rojgar Karyalaya jivit panjiyan) in Chhattisgarh. Age Limit: The candidate must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01 September 2026. Age relaxations apply as per circulars issued from time to time by the Chhattisgarh General Administration Department. Experience (Weightage): Work experience in government rural development schemes at an equal or higher pay scale carries additional marks in selection (5 marks for 1 to 2 years, 10 marks for 2 to 5 years, and 15 marks for more than 5 years). Experience elsewhere will not be counted. To claim marks for experience, candidates must attach: (1) copy of appointment order, (2) experience certificate, and (3) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer. Ineligibility / Disqualifications: Candidates having more than two living children, with one born on or after 26 January 2001, are not eligible for appointment. Disqualifications under Rule 1961 of the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (General Conditions of Service) will also apply. Furthermore, personnel previously dismissed or whose contract extensions were discontinued by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department due to irregularities are not eligible to apply. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointees will receive a consolidated monthly honorarium as determined under the guidelines approved by the Finance Department and Chhattisgarh State Government. The official notification does not mention the in-hand salary or exact remuneration amount. No special pay, dearness allowance (DA), house rent allowance (HRA), or compensation rent allowance will be payable on top of the consolidated pay. Eligibility for pay increments will be governed by Finance Department sanctions and government directives under contract appointment rules. The appointment is purely temporary and on a contract basis under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2012 for an initial duration of 1 year. Leave entitlement will be governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2012. The contract may be extended for an additional period of 1 year based on work requirements, efficiency, conduct, government directions, and mutual agreement between both parties. Selected candidates are required to execute an agreement contract on a Rs 50 stamp paper with the employer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Panchayat Kanker, Chhattisgarh Accountant (Contract)
content_sections.text: Access the designated online registration portal at zpkanker.indicompute.com or through www.kanker.gov.in. Fill in personal details, residential address, category, and active Chhattisgarh employment registration number. Candidates will be solely responsible for any incorrect entry, and no correction will be permitted once submitted. Enter academic qualifications including Higher Secondary and B.Com details, along with marks obtained. Upload self-attested copies of essential certificates including the Chhattisgarh local resident certificate, permanent caste certificate, live employment exchange card, mark sheets, and medical board certificate (for PwD candidates). Attach the appointment order, experience certificate, and current employer NOC if claiming marks for experience in government rural development schemes. Submit the online application before the closing time of 12:00 midnight on 01 November 2026. Late applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Merit List, Document Verification, and a Computer Practical Exam based on a 100-mark evaluation system. There is no personal interview. Based on applications received, a preliminary eligible/ineligible list for claims and objections will be published on the district panchayat notice board and on www.kanker.gov.in. Only one opportunity will be provided to rectify any clerical error during the claims and objections stage; no claim/objection will be entertained after the due date. Thereafter, eligible candidates will be invited for document verification in a 1:5 ratio. Candidates who successfully clear document verification will be shortlisted on merit for the 15-mark Computer Practical Exam. Candidates must carry an original photo identity card (Aadhaar Card or PAN Card) for identification. The final selection will be subject to the writ petition pending before the High Court of Chhattisgarh at Bilaspur regarding reservation.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under District Panchayat Kanker Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 contract vacancies for the post of Accountant (Contract) across Unreserved (1), ST (2), and OBC (1) categories.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for District Panchayat Kanker Accountant?
faq.answer: The deadline to submit the online application form is 01 November 2026 at 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates, or a second class pass for Bastar and Sarguja division residents).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for District Panchayat Kanker Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01 September 2026, with age relaxations applicable per Chhattisgarh government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Accountant (Contract) post in District Panchayat Kanker?
faq.answer: The post offers a consolidated monthly honorarium as sanctioned by the Finance Department, but the exact salary amount is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for District Panchayat Kanker Accountant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for District Panchayat Kanker Accountant (Contract)?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-mark merit calculation comprising academic weightage (70 marks), work experience (up to 15 marks), and a Computer Practical Exam (15 marks), preceded by document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Accountant post at District Panchayat Kanker permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a contract basis for an initial term of 1 year, extendable by 1 year based on satisfactory performance and mutual agreement.

faq.question: Q9. Are allowances like DA and HRA paid for this Accountant post?
faq.answer: No, candidates receive a fixed consolidated pay without any special pay, dearness allowance, or house rent allowance.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of educational mark sheets, a Chhattisgarh domicile certificate, a permanent caste certificate (if applicable), an active employment exchange registration card, and experience/NOC certificates if claiming experience marks.
